scenarios.title: Act 2: place the Staff in the orifice on the generic step executor (quests.stepExec=1)
scenarios.provenance: CHEATED: Act 2 start in Lut Gholein by the goto verb, level 24, gold, waypoints, Andariel and act-complete words, a Rogue merc and basic gear by SETUP verbs. Mechanics only. Raw stats: strength 90, dexterity 60, max life 1200, a rare broad sword (stands for a geared hero). Unused stat points are set to 0 (the raw stats stand for a spent hero; unspent points made the bot cancel its boss run for the point spender). The assembled Horadric Staff is given by a SETUP verb (the assemble row covers the Cube). qd25: max life 6000 and no merc again (the 2000 life hero dies to the Burning Dead of tomb 66, V run 20261125-192625). Record 10 is 0x0c08 (3080): the word after Cain's talk (0x0c78) as the d2d keeps it after the join (bits 4 to 6 cleared, V rerun 2026-11-27); bit 11 = the Staff made, bit 0 clear (bit 0 reads as the Staff already placed and the orifice drops it; placefix).
scenarios.notes: Card stepexec1 (Act 2 chunk): drill.act2.duriel with the executor on. The orifice click runs the data row seven_tombs/place_staff and waits until hst has left the pack. Green 2 of 3 runs is the enable criterion (data/darklaunch.json). NOT run yet.
